name: graphics-plus
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: A different look for the whole game: painted grass and ferns on grassy ground, water that reflects the world and glows teal along the shore, a warm sun on the maps you choose, shadows from buildings and trees, lamp glows from each map's own lights, colour grading, tone mapping and a vignette, with haze, tilt-shift, colour fringing and drops on the lens to taste. Every effect has its own switch. Also the worked example of api.graphics.

settings.label: Colour grading
settings.description: Warm light and cool shadows, with a little more contrast. 0 is off.

settings.label: Warm sunlight
settings.description: A golden sun and a cooler sky in place of each map's own light, everywhere. 0 (the default) keeps every map's own light; use the list below to warm only some maps.

settings.label: Sunlight per map
settings.description: Maps that differ from the setting above, as name:strength (0-100). With the setting above at 0, only these maps are warmed, e.g. "izlude:100 prt_fild*:80"; with it above 0, these override it, e.g. "*_dun*:0 *_in:0" to leave dungeons and indoors alone. * matches anything; the first match wins.

settings.label: Lamp glow
settings.description: A soft glow around every light the map places: lamps, torches, braziers. 0 is off.

settings.label: Water reflections
settings.description: Water mirrors the buildings, rocks and sky above it. Draws the map a second time on maps with water, so it costs more than the others. 0 is off.

settings.label: Water waves
settings.description: The map's own animated waves on top of the reflections, everywhere. 0 shows only the reflections (Izlude's clear look); use the list below for particular maps.

settings.label: Water waves per map
settings.description: Maps that differ from the setting above, as name:strength (0-100), e.g. "alberta:70 izlude:0". * matches anything; the first match wins.

settings.label: High-resolution ground
settings.description: Keeps the full detail of larger ground textures from a texture pack mod (the client otherwise shrinks every ground texture to 256x256). Needs such a pack installed -- without one there is nothing to sharpen.

settings.label: Grass
settings.description: Tufts of grass on grassy ground, coloured by the ground under them and swaying in the wind. Higher is denser. 0 is off.

settings.label: Painted trees
settings.description: The common trees drawn from painted 3D models (Quaternius's Stylized Nature MegaKit, CC0) instead of the map's own: the broadleaf trees of the fields and towns, and the conifers. Palms stay as they are. Takes effect on the next map you enter.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.description: Shadows from buildings and trees in the map's sun, on the ground and on other buildings, where the map has none baked in. 0 is off.

settings.label: Shadow quality
settings.description: The size of the shadow map: 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096. Lower is softer and lighter on the GPU.

settings.label: Contact shadows
settings.description: Soft darkening where walls meet the ground, under eaves and around crates and trees (ambient occlusion). 0 is off.

settings.label: Distance haze
settings.description: Far things fade into the map's own light colour. Needs WebGL 2; 0 is off.

settings.label: Tone mapping
settings.description: Bright areas roll off instead of clipping to white, which matters most with bloom on. 0 is off.

settings.label: Vignette
settings.description: Darkens the corners. 0 is off.

settings.label: Tilt-shift blur
settings.description: Blurs the top and bottom of the screen, like a miniature photograph. 0 is off.

settings.label: Colour fringing
settings.description: Splits colour slightly toward the edges, like a camera lens. 0 is off.

settings.label: Drops on the lens
settings.description: Small water drops low on the camera, each a tiny lens, on the maps listed below. 0 is off.

settings.label: Maps with a wet lens
settings.description: The maps where drops gather on the camera: names separated by spaces, * matches anything ("*" is everywhere, empty is never).
